subject: Re: ApexAI pilot — next steps & MPA draft
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@apexai.com>, Janelle Wu <janelle.wu@apexai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: ApexAI pilot — summary & proposed MPA (first draft)

Hi Liam + Janelle,

Thanks again for a focused call earlier — appreciated the clear description of the latency spikes you've seen during peak inference windows and the concern about embedding consistency across models. Quick recap of the pain and goals we heard: 

- Pain: 200–300ms tail latency spikes at 95th percentile for batch requests during end-of-day processing; intermittent increases when you failover between regions.
- Risk: audit and data residency for EU customers requires an isolated VPC option for model telemetry.
- Goal: Bring 95th percentile latency within 120–150ms for production traffic while keeping per-token cost below your current threshold (~$0.0009/token equivalent).

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MPA) in XLS format with proposed milestones, owners, and dates (apex_mpa_v1.xlsx). Core milestones I propose:

1) Evaluation kickoff — week of Nov 15: environment access + test dataset ingestion (Owner: Apex AI engineering)
2) Performance run — Nov 22–29: Redwood runs perf matrix across model variants; we share a runbook (attached) and initial latency/cost numbers (Owner: Redwood SRE)
3) Security & compliance review — week of Dec 6: deliver SOC-2 questionnaire answers & network diagram (Owner: Apex procurement + Redwood security)
4) Commercial terms & contract signature — target Dec 17 (Owner: Apex procurement + Redwood sales)
5) Pilot to production cutover — Jan 11, 2027 (Owner: Apex product + Redwood delivery)

Stakeholders listed in the sheet — I put Janelle as primary procurement contact, Liam as technical sponsor, and added our SRE lead (Aditya) for performance scoping.

Open items we need from your side right away:
- Shared test dataset link or S3 access for perf runs
- A short list of 3 representative production prompts and typical sequence lengths
- Confirmation on whether EU-resident telemetry requires an air-gapped export or customer-managed KMS

If that aligns, I’ll mark this as version 1 and schedule a quick 20-minute sync for Wednesday Nov 10 to walk the plan with your procurement and infra teams.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0149

Attachments: apex_mpa_v1.xlsx, redwood-performance-runbook.pdf
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@apexai.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: ApexAI pilot — summary & proposed MPA (first draft)

Thanks Chloe — this is exactly the kind of structure we wanted. Quick notes / clarifications: 

- Dataset: I can share an S3 read-only link with a limited subset by EOD today. Will include the 3 representative prompts.
- Telemetry/KMS: Procurement prefers customer-managed KMS; security will flag any telemetry that leaves the EU. We will need a simple data flow diagram from Redwood to show where logs land.
- Dates: The Nov 22–29 perf window works but can we get a dry run the week prior to validate our ingestion pipeline?

One ask on scope: can Redwood test both the quantized fp16 path and an 8-bit quantized run? That would help us understand cost vs latency tradeoffs.

I’m copying Janelle to confirm procurement availability — Janelle, are you available for a 20-minute sync Wednesday Nov 10 at 11:00am PT?

—Liam

Chloe — noted. A few internal points before we confirm the dry run: 

- Perf plan: We can run a dry ingestion test Nov 16 and a full perf matrix Nov 22–25 instead of Nov 22–29 to shorten the window. That still gives us time to iterate on quantization configs.
- Models: I'll include two variants in the runbook: fp16 baseline + 8-bit dynamic quantization (we'll measure quality drift on the 3 prompts).
- EU telemetry: We can provide a network diagram and an option to disable telemetry export by customer for EU projects. If they insist on customer-managed KMS, we need their KMS ARN before the security review.

Pricing note: If Apex signs by Dec 17, we can offer a limited first-year pilot discount (10%) tied to usage thresholds; sales to confirm exact wording.

I'll flag Priyom to prepare a short SLO checklist that we can hand to their infra team. Chloe — want me to join the Wed Nov 10 sync?
